_readme: Provenance record AND rebuild recipe for the gitignored .bakery-runs/ inputs behind mini-corpus.json. The tunes themselves are NOT vendored — see mini-corpus-manifest.mjs. Regenerate deliberately with `node packages/app/scripts/mini-corpus-manifest.mjs generate`; rebuild the inputs with `... restore`. Checked by mini-corpus-inputs.test.ts.
